core_summary.short: The zombie-ant fungus, Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato, is a parasitic fungus that infects mainly carpenter ants, changes their behavior, kills them, and then grows a stalk from the dead ant to release spores.
core_summary.medium: Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l. infects formicine ants, especially Camponotus carpenter ants. Spores attach to an ant, germinate, penetrate the exoskeleton, grow through the body, and manipulate behavior so the ant leaves normal trails, climbs vegetation, and bites down in a death grip. After death, the fungus digests/mummifies the cadaver and produces a fruiting stalk that releases spores. The system is strongly affected by habitat, microclimate, host species, and fungal species diversity.
core_summary.simulation_angle: A simulator can model the fungus as a multi-stage parasite with probabilistic infection, host behavior manipulation, environmental modifiers, ant colony defenses, and spore dispersal from infected cadavers.

taxonomy.broad_scientific_usage: Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato / O. unilateralis s.l.
taxonomy_notes: The taxonomy is contentious because what is often called O. unilateralis may represent a species complex.
Some research suggests different carpenter ant species may be associated with different fungal species.
Use 'sensu lato' when speaking broadly about the complex rather than one narrowly defined species.

hosts.host_specificity: Likely high; specific fungus lineages may specialize on particular ant hosts.
hosts.human_infection_note: The real zombie-ant fungus does not infect humans. Human zombie scenarios in games/shows are fictional extrapolations.

simulation_implications: Increase spore survival and fruiting success in humid zones.
Make forest-floor contact increase infection risk.
Use habitat type to decide whether ants bite leaves or twigs.
Let temperature and humidity affect stalk development time and spore release success.

life_cycle.description: The fungus begins as a sticky spore in the environment, often on the forest floor or near areas where ants pass.
If a spore attaches to an ant, it can germinate and produce infective hyphae that breach the ant exoskeleton.
After entering the body, the fungus grows through host tissues and may suppress host immune and stress responses.
The infected ant leaves normal routines, stops following established trails, becomes less responsive, has convulsions, falls from canopy, wanders, then climbs vegetation.

sim_rules.movement_bias: toward warm, humid, low vegetation suitable for spore dispersal

life_cycle.description: The ant locks its mandibles onto a leaf vein, leaf margin, or twig. This biting behavior secures the ant before death.
After death, fungal tissue continues to colonize the ant body, digesting and mummifying the cadaver while protecting it from scavengers and microbes.

sim_rules.defense_feature: fungal growth may protect the cadaver as a resource

life_cycle.description: The fungus grows a stalk from the ant, often from the head/neck region, and releases spores from reproductive structures to continue the cycle.

sim_rules.spore_cloud_radius: depends on height, humidity, airflow, and substrate position

infected_ant_behaviors: leaves nest outside normal foraging time
does not follow established ant trails
reduced response to external stimuli, including other ants
falls from canopy to forest floor
orients body in a specific position

death_grip.definition: A final biting/mandible-locking behavior that fixes the dying ant to vegetation.
death_grip.function: Keeps the cadaver in a position favorable for fungal development and spore dispersal.
death_grip.ecosystem_variation: Rainforest cases are often associated with leaves; warm-temperate cases may use twigs.

graveyards.definition: Clusters of dead infected ants attached to vegetation, sometimes at similar heights or locations.
graveyards.simulation_use: Create infection hotspots where spore density and future infection risk are higher.

mechanisms.important_note: The fungus does not appear to simply 'enter the brain and control the mind.' The mechanism is more complex and involves body tissues, gene expression, muscle interaction, and chemical signaling.

known_or_suggested_mechanisms.details: The fungus may activate or suppress ant genes during infection, including genes related to immune and stress responses.
Fungal cells can invade host muscle fibers and may contribute to tremors and biting behavior.
Gene expression linked to tryptophan metabolism may be involved in tremors and biting behavior.
The fungus may secrete compounds near the central and peripheral nervous systems, influencing behavior without directly occupying the brain.
Unusual toxins may interfere with chemical signaling between ants.
The research excerpt suggests host-pathogen interaction may involve complex molecular regulation before visible protein-expression effects.

simulation_abstraction.recommended_model: Use a hidden infection_progress value that changes movement, response, trail-following, and biting probability once thresholds are crossed.
simulation_abstraction.avoid_overclaiming: Do not describe it as direct brain takeover unless it is explicitly fictionalized.

adaptations.name: arboreal behavior
adaptations.description: Carpenter ants in infested areas may spend more time above the forest floor, reducing contact with spores.

adaptations.name: social grooming
adaptations.description: Ants can remove spores from each other before infection succeeds.

adaptations.name: removal of infected members
adaptations.description: Colonies may carry infected ants away from the nest or high-traffic trails to reduce spread.

adaptations.name: graveyard avoidance
adaptations.description: Ants may avoid areas with dead infected ants, lowering exposure to spore hotspots.

simulation_rules: Add a grooming action that reduces attached_spore_count.
Add colony hygiene behavior that moves infected ants away from nest nodes.
Add avoidance pathfinding around graveyard cells once detected.
Make arboreal ants less exposed to forest-floor spores but still vulnerable in infected vegetation zones.

species_complex_and_biodiversity.main_claim: O. unilateralis sensu lato likely represents a complex of many related species rather than a single simple species everywhere.
important_points: The fungus has a broad pantropical distribution on formicine ants.
Research in Brazilian Atlantic Forest fragments found unexpected diversity within the complex.
There may be tens or hundreds of species still to delimit within the complex if similar patterns occur globally.
Symbiotic lifestyles can drive speciation, so host-specific fungal lineages may be common.
Fungal diversity in tropical ecosystems is probably underdescribed.
simulation_use: Represent multiple fungal strains/species with different host preferences.
Make fungal lineages specialize on different ant species.
Use biome-specific traits: rainforest strains favor leaf biting; temperate strains may favor twig biting.
Let new fungal variants emerge through mutation/evolution mechanics.

morphology.ascospores: Large sexual spores can be released under pressure from structures on the stalk.

host_pathogen_system.environmental_timing: The system may be timed with ant activity and suitable microclimatic conditions such as light, temperature, and humidity.

rag_chunks.title: Basic identity
rag_chunks.text: Zombie-ant fungus, Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato, is a parasitic fungus that mainly infects carpenter ants in the genus Camponotus. It changes host behavior before killing the ant and using the cadaver to release spores.

rag_chunks.title: Taxonomy
rag_chunks.text: The fungus belongs to Kingdom Fungi, Phylum Ascomycota, Class Sordariomycetes, Order Hypocreales, Family Ophiocordycipitaceae, Genus Ophiocordyceps. It was formerly placed in Cordyceps and is still sometimes called cordyceps.

rag_chunks.title: Spore to infection
rag_chunks.text: The life cycle can begin when a sticky spore attaches to a passing carpenter ant. The spore germinates and produces hyphae that penetrate the ant's exoskeleton, allowing the fungus to grow inside the body.

rag_chunks.title: Manipulation and death grip
rag_chunks.text: After internal growth, the fungus manipulates the ant so it leaves normal behavior patterns, climbs vegetation, and bites down permanently. This death grip secures the ant in a location favorable for fungal growth and spore dispersal.

rag_chunks.title: Zombie-like symptoms
rag_chunks.text: Infected ants may stop following trails, become less responsive to other ants, convulse, fall from the canopy, wander without clear direction, climb low vegetation, and lock their mandibles onto a plant before dying.

rag_chunks.title: Not simple brain takeover
rag_chunks.text: The fungus does not seem to directly enter the ant brain. Instead, it may affect gene expression, muscle fibers, nervous-system signaling, and chemical communication. This makes the real mechanism more complex than simple mind control.

rag_chunks.title: Host-pathogen challenges
rag_chunks.text: The fungus must attach to and penetrate the exoskeleton, avoid or suppress host defenses, manipulate behavior, kill the host, protect the cadaver from decay and scavengers, and then produce spores from the dead ant.

rag_chunks.title: Ant defenses
rag_chunks.text: Carpenter ants may reduce infection risk by avoiding spore-heavy forest-floor areas, grooming spores off each other, moving infected colony members away from trails or nests, and avoiding infected-ant graveyards.

rag_chunks.title: Habitat and microclimate
rag_chunks.text: Zombie-ant fungus is most common in tropical forests but can also occur in warm-temperate forests. Light, temperature, humidity, vegetation type, and ant activity can affect the success of spore release and infection.

rag_chunks.title: Species complex
rag_chunks.text: Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato may include many species or lineages, potentially with different host ants and regional adaptations. Tropical forests may contain large amounts of undescribed fungal diversity.

rag_chunks.title: Suggested infection-state system
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, model infection as states: healthy, spore attached, germinating, internal infection, manipulated behavior, death grip, dead cadaver, fruiting body, and spore releasing. Let humidity, temperature, grooming, host species, and fungal strain modify transitions.

rag_chunks.title: Human infection accuracy
rag_chunks.text: The real zombie-ant fungus does not infect humans. Fictional human zombie stories inspired by cordyceps should be treated as speculative fiction, not real biology.

rag_chunks.title: Insect cuticle as the first battlefield
rag_chunks.text: The insect cuticle and epicuticle are the first battlefield between entomopathogenic fungi and insect hosts. The decisive early interaction occurs when a fungal spore contacts the insect surface; successful adhesion, germination, and penetration can lead to mycosis, while surface defenses can stop infection before the fungus reaches internal tissues. 中文总结：昆虫病原真菌感染昆虫时，最早、也可能最关键的互动发生在真菌孢子和昆虫表皮/上表皮之间。昆虫 cuticle 是真菌必须突破的第一道屏障；如果真菌成功黏附、萌发并穿透，就可能进入 mycosis；如果宿主在表面阶段阻止孢子，感染就可能失败。

rag_chunks.title: Attachment, germination, and penetration
rag_chunks.text: Entomopathogenic fungi can infect insects by directly penetrating the cuticle rather than entering only through the mouth or wounds. A typical sequence is spore attachment to the hydrophobic epicuticle, germination, hyphal growth, secretion of proteases, chitinases, lipases and other hydrolytic enzymes, and mechanical penetration with structures such as penetration pegs or appressoria. 中文总结：昆虫病原真菌通常不需要从口器或伤口进入宿主，而是可以从 cuticle 表面直接侵入。感染流程可概括为：孢子附着在疏水性的上表皮，萌发形成菌丝，分泌 proteases、chitinases、lipases 等水解酶，并通过 penetration peg 或 appressorium 等结构向内穿透。宿主免疫系统往往是在真菌越过表皮后才强烈参与。

rag_chunks.title: Hydrophobins and adhesins help fungal spores stick
rag_chunks.text: Fungal adhesion to insect cuticle involves hydrophobic surface binding and stronger attachment mechanisms. Beauveria bassiana and Metarhizium anisopliae produce hydrophobic conidia with hydrophobins that form a rodlet layer and support adhesion; the Metarhizium Mad1 adhesin is linked to insect cuticle adhesion, germination, blastospore production, and virulence, whereas Mad2 is more associated with plant surfaces. 中文总结：真菌孢子对昆虫上表皮的黏附包括较非特异的疏水吸附和后续更稳定的附着。Beauveria bassiana 和 Metarhizium anisopliae 的疏水孢子表面含 hydrophobins，帮助形成 rodlet layer、提高疏水性并增强黏附；Metarhizium 的 Mad1 adhesin 与昆虫 cuticle 黏附、萌发和毒力相关，而 Mad2 更偏向植物表面互作。

rag_chunks.title: Cuticular lipids can feed or block fungi
rag_chunks.text: Epicuticular waxes contain hydrocarbons, fatty acids, esters, alcohols, ketones, aldehydes and other lipids. These cuticular lipids can serve as carbon sources for Beauveria and Metarhizium and induce cytochrome P450s, catalases, lipases and esterases, but some insect lipids and aldehydes can also inhibit fungal adhesion, germination or hyphal growth. 中文总结：昆虫 epicuticle 的蜡质层含 hydrocarbons、fatty acids、esters、alcohols、ketones 和 aldehydes 等成分。这些 cuticular lipids 一方面可作为 Beauveria 或 Metarhizium 的碳源，诱导 cytochrome P450、catalases、lipase/esterases 等代谢系统；另一方面，不同昆虫的脂质和醛类也可能抑制真菌附着、萌发或菌丝生长。

rag_chunks.title: Chemical and structural cuticle defenses
rag_chunks.text: Insects defend the cuticle with structural and chemical mechanisms such as antimicrobial lipids, aldehydes, benzoquinones, toxins, protease and chitinase inhibitors, antimicrobial peptides, melanization, and sclerotization. Melanin or hardened cuticle can make penetration by fungal enzymes and mechanical pressure more difficult, although outcomes vary by insect species and fungal strain. 中文总结：昆虫可通过 cuticle 的结构和化学特性抵御真菌：抗菌脂质、醛类、苯醌、毒素、蛋白酶抑制剂、chitinase/protease inhibitors、抗菌肽和 melanization 都可能降低孢子萌发或穿透成功率。melanin 或硬化组织可能使 cuticle 更难被机械压力和真菌水解酶突破，但不同昆虫和真菌组合的效果差异很大。

rag_chunks.title: Molting, symbionts, grooming, and behavioral fever
rag_chunks.text: Insects also reduce fungal infection through molting, symbiotic microbes, grooming, burrowing, sunbathing, UV exposure, corpse removal, and behavioral fever. Symbionts such as Wolbachia, Streptomyces, Burkholderia, or actinobacteria may provide antifungal protection, while grooming and social hygiene can remove spores before penetration. 中文总结：除表皮化学防御外，昆虫还能用发育、共生微生物和行为来降低感染：molting 可脱去带有孢子的旧表皮；某些 Wolbachia、Streptomyces、Burkholderia 或 actinobacteria 共生体可提供抗真菌帮助；grooming、群体清洁、病体移除、burrowing、sunbathing 和 behavioral fever 可减少孢子、改变温度或利用 UV 限制真菌生长。

rag_chunks.title: Surface arms race affects virulence and biocontrol
rag_chunks.text: Fungal virulence and insect surface defenses are under reciprocal coevolutionary pressure. Surface interactions can affect fungal strain variation, host range, increased virulence after insect passage, and the reliability of mycoinsecticides in field biocontrol. For a simulator, infection probability can depend on humidity, temperature, cuticular lipid composition, melanization, grooming, molting, symbionts, and fungal enzyme levels. 中文总结：真菌毒力和宿主表面防御处在共同进化的拉锯中。cuticle 表面的相互作用会影响菌株差异、宿主范围、传代后毒力增强以及田间生防效果。用于 simulator 时，可把湿度、温度、cuticle lipid composition、melanization、grooming、molting、symbionts 和 fungal enzyme level 作为影响感染概率与阶段转移的变量。

rag_chunks.title: Ophiocordyceps manipulation may combine infection and behavior programs
rag_chunks.text: A 2024 review frames Ophiocordyceps ant manipulation as an infection strategy that increases parasite transmission rather than as simple mind control. Current hypotheses connect infection biology, secreted parasite molecules, host tissue changes, and timed behavioral shifts such as leaving the nest, climbing, and death grip. 中文总结：这篇综述把 Ophiocordyceps 对木匠蚁的行为操控理解为提高传播成功率的感染策略，而不是简单的“控制大脑”。研究假说把感染过程、寄生物分泌分子、宿主组织变化，以及离巢、攀爬、死亡紧咬等定时行为变化联系起来。

rag_chunks.title: Parasite-secreted proteins as candidate manipulation tools
rag_chunks.text: Research on Ophiocordyceps and related manipulating parasites suggests that secreted parasite proteins are likely involved in infection and host behavioral manipulation. These proteins are candidate effectors because they can interact with host tissues, alter physiology, and help the parasite coordinate infection with behavioral outcomes. 中文总结：Ophiocordyceps 及其他行为操控型寄生物的研究提示，寄生物分泌蛋白很可能参与感染和宿主行为改变。这些蛋白可被视为候选 effector，因为它们可能与宿主组织互作、改变生理状态，并帮助寄生物把感染进程和行为结果连接起来。

rag_chunks.title: Light-driven rhythms may time manipulation
rag_chunks.text: The review highlights light-driven biological rhythms as a likely part of Ophiocordyceps infection and manipulation biology. Circadian or environmental timing cues may help synchronize parasite development with host behaviors and with transmission-friendly conditions, such as the timing of climbing or biting. 中文总结：综述强调，光驱动的生物节律可能是 Ophiocordyceps 感染和操控机制的一部分。昼夜节律或环境光线信号可能帮助真菌把自身发育、宿主行为变化和有利传播的环境条件同步起来，例如何时攀爬或咬附。

rag_chunks.title: Compare Ophiocordyceps with Hypocreales and Entomophthorales
rag_chunks.text: To ask whether Ophiocordyceps mechanisms are unique or widespread, the review compares it with related insect- and plant-infecting Hypocreales and with behavior-manipulating Entomophthorales. Similar outcomes across distant parasite groups may reflect convergent evolution, while similarities among close relatives may point to shared ancestral infection toolkits. 中文总结：为了回答 Ophiocordyceps 的机制是独特还是普遍存在，综述把它与较近缘的昆虫/植物感染型 Hypocreales，以及同样能操控昆虫行为的 Entomophthorales 比较。远缘类群出现相似行为结果，可能说明趋同演化；近缘类群的相似机制则可能来自共享的祖先感染工具。

rag_chunks.title: Unique or ubiquitous mechanisms remain a research question
rag_chunks.text: The key question of the review is whether Ophiocordyceps infection and behavioral manipulation mechanisms are unique to this ant-fungus system or represent more general strategies that evolved repeatedly in parasites. The current evidence supports functional hypotheses rather than final answers, so future studies need to test which molecular mechanisms are specific, shared, or convergently evolved. 中文总结：这篇综述的核心问题是：Ophiocordyceps 的感染和行为操控机制是否是这个蚂蚁-真菌系统独有的，还是寄生物中多次演化出的普遍策略。目前证据更适合提出功能假说，而不是给出定论；未来研究需要区分哪些机制是特异的、共享的或趋同演化的。

rag_chunks.title: Simulation rules for molecular and rhythmic manipulation
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, this review supports modeling infected ants with internal variables such as fungal load, secreted effector activity, light or circadian phase, and transmission readiness. Behavior changes can be triggered when infection level and timing cues align, making manipulation staged and environmentally timed rather than random. 中文总结：用于 simulator 时，可以把感染蚂蚁建模为拥有 fungal load、secreted effector activity、light/circadian phase 和 transmission readiness 等内部变量。当感染程度和光照/节律线索同时满足时，再触发离巢、攀爬、死亡紧咬等行为，使行为操控呈现分阶段、受环境时机影响的特点，而不是随机发生。

rag_chunks.title: Mixed transcriptomics during zombie ant biting
rag_chunks.text: De Bekker et al. experimentally infected Camponotus castaneus carpenter ants with Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato and sampled ant heads during manipulated biting and shortly after death. Using mixed RNA-Seq, they measured both fungal and host gene expression in the same parasite-host interaction. 中文总结：研究者用 O. unilateralis s.l. 实验感染 C. castaneus 木匠蚁，在死亡紧咬发生时和紧咬后死亡阶段采集蚂蚁头部，进行 mixed transcriptomics，同时观察真菌和宿主在同一感染事件中的基因表达。

rag_chunks.title: Manipulated biting and death are synchronized
rag_chunks.text: In the laboratory, infected ants that died 16-24 days after infection showed stereotyped manipulated biting. Live biting ants were found around 09:00, collected during manipulation at 10:00, showed reduced movement by 13:00, and appeared dead by 14:00. This supports the idea that biting and death are synchronized and may be controlled by daily timing cues. 中文总结：实验中，感染后 16-24 天死亡的蚂蚁会出现典型咬附姿势；早上约 09:00 仍活着并咬住基质，10:00 采集“操控中”样本，13:00 运动减少，14:00 基本死亡。这说明死亡紧咬和宿主死亡具有同步性，可能受日节律或环境时机影响。

rag_chunks.title: Ophiocordyceps genome contains many unique secreted proteins
rag_chunks.text: The South Carolina Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l. genome was about 26.05 Mb with 7,831 predicted genes. About 11.4% of genes encoded putatively secreted proteins; 33% of secreted proteins and about 49% of small secreted proteins were unique to this Ophiocordyceps genome, making them strong candidate effectors for specialized manipulation. 中文总结：该研究组装的 O. unilateralis s.l. 基因组约 26.05 Mb，预测 7,831 个基因，其中约 11.4% 编码潜在分泌蛋白。分泌蛋白中约 33%、小分泌蛋白中约 49% 是该基因组独有，提示这些 SSPs 可能是专门参与行为操控的候选效应蛋白。

rag_chunks.title: Most genes up during biting are not conserved in other insect fungi
rag_chunks.text: During manipulated biting, many Ophiocordyceps genes that were up-regulated and then down-regulated after death were not conserved in other Hypocrealean insect pathogens. The paper reports that about 80-82% of genes specifically associated with manipulated biting were absent from non-manipulating insect-infecting fungi, suggesting a specialized gene set for death-grip behavior. 中文总结：死亡紧咬期间上调、紧咬后又下调的许多真菌基因，在其他 Hypocreales 昆虫病原真菌中并不保守。论文指出，与操控咬附相关的约 80-82% 基因不见于非操控型昆虫病原真菌，说明 O. unilateralis 可能使用一套较独特的基因组合来建立死亡紧咬。

rag_chunks.title: Candidate fungal manipulators include alkaloids, PTPs, CYPs and SSPs
rag_chunks.text: Candidate Ophiocordyceps manipulators up-regulated during biting include genes linked to ergot-like alkaloids, indole diterpene alkaloids such as penitrem-like compounds, NRPSs, PKSs, cytochrome P450s, tyrosinases, protein-tyrosine phosphatases, sphingomyelinase, lipocalin-like proteins, kynurenine pathway enzymes, and many SSPs with unknown functions. These could affect neurotransmission, muscle activity, inflammation, redox state, or host cell regulation. 中文总结：死亡紧咬期间上调的候选真菌操控因子包括麦角样生物碱、indole diterpene / penitrem 类代谢、NRPS、PKS、CYP、tyrosinase、protein-tyrosine phosphatase、sphingomyelinase、lipocalin 样蛋白、kynurenine 通路酶以及大量功能未知 SSPs。这些因子可能影响神经递质、肌肉活动、炎症、氧化还原状态或宿主细胞调控。

rag_chunks.title: Enterotoxins may impair ant chemical communication
rag_chunks.text: Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l. had an unusual expansion of bacterial-like enterotoxin genes, with dynamic expression during and after biting. Because social insects rely heavily on chemical signals, these secreted toxins may help disrupt chemosensory communication; infected ants also showed down-regulation of odorant and gustatory receptors and binding proteins. 中文总结：O. unilateralis s.l. 基因组中有异常扩张的细菌样 enterotoxin 基因，并在咬附前后动态表达。由于社会性昆虫高度依赖化学信号，这些分泌毒素可能削弱宿主化学通讯；同时，感染蚂蚁中气味和味觉感知相关受体及结合蛋白也出现下调。

rag_chunks.title: Manipulated ants show suppressed immune and stress genes
rag_chunks.text: During manipulated biting, many host immune and stress response genes were down-regulated in ant heads, including pathogen recognition genes, prophenoloxidase, antimicrobial peptides such as defensins, and oxidoreductase-related genes. This suggests Ophiocordyceps may suppress host immune and neuronal stress responses long enough to complete manipulation before killing the host. 中文总结：在死亡紧咬期间，蚂蚁头部许多免疫和压力反应基因下调，包括病原识别、prophenoloxidase、defensin 等抗菌肽以及氧化还原相关基因。这提示 Ophiocordyceps 可能压制宿主免疫和神经压力反应，使宿主在死亡前保持可被操控的状态。

rag_chunks.title: Host neural, clock, sensory and muscle pathways are candidate targets
rag_chunks.text: Host genes altered during biting point to several possible manipulation targets: octopamine receptor and dopamine biosynthesis genes may affect locomotion and mandible movement; period and cycle clock genes may alter daily timing; odorant receptors and odorant-binding proteins were down-regulated; collagen and muscle LIM genes were down-regulated, consistent with mandibular muscle atrophy and lock-jaw fixation. 中文总结：咬附期间改变的宿主基因指向多个可能被操控的通路：octopamine receptor 和 dopamine 合成相关基因可能影响运动和下颚动作；period 与 cycle 等 clock genes 可能改变日节律；气味受体和气味结合蛋白下调；collagen 与 muscle LIM 基因下调，与下颚肌肉萎缩和 lock-jaw 固定相吻合。

rag_chunks.title: Gene expression shifts after manipulation from parasitic to saprophytic growth
rag_chunks.text: After biting and presumed host death, Ophiocordyceps gene expression shifted: carbohydrate processing genes increased, while many pathogenesis, secondary metabolism, oxidation-reduction, and secreted protein genes decreased. This suggests a transition from manipulating and maintaining a living host to consuming dead host tissue and preparing for external growth and reproduction. 中文总结：咬附完成并宿主死亡后，真菌表达模式发生转换：糖类加工相关基因上升，而许多致病性、次级代谢、氧化还原和分泌蛋白相关基因下降。这说明真菌从“操控并维持活宿主”的寄生阶段，转向“消耗死亡宿主组织并准备外部生长繁殖”的腐生阶段。

rag_chunks.title: Simulation rules from zombie ant gene expression
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, this study supports using hidden infection variables such as fungal biomass in the head, manipulation gene activity, secreted effector level, host immune suppression, sensory disruption, clock phase, mandible muscle damage, and saprophytic transition. Death grip should occur only when multiple conditions align, reflecting the complex and precise nature of fungal behavioral manipulation. 中文总结：用于 simulator 时，可把蚂蚁感染状态建模为多个隐藏变量：头部真菌量、操控基因活性、分泌效应蛋白水平、宿主免疫压制、感觉干扰、节律阶段、下颚肌肉损伤和腐生阶段转换。死亡紧咬应在多个条件同时满足时触发，以体现真菌行为操控的复杂性和精确性。

rag_chunks.title: FAQ: gene expression changes during death grip
rag_chunks.text: 死亡紧咬期间 Ophiocordyceps 和蚂蚁有哪些基因表达变化？During zombie ant death-grip biting, fungal Ophiocordyceps genes for secreted proteins, SSP effectors, alkaloid and secondary metabolite biosynthesis, cytochrome P450s, protein-tyrosine phosphatases, enterotoxins, and redox-related processes are up-regulated. In the ant host, immune and stress genes, odorant and gustatory perception genes, and muscle integrity genes tend to be down-regulated, while candidate neural, dopamine/octopamine, PTP, apoptosis, and clock genes such as period and cycle can be altered. 中文总结：死亡紧咬期间，真菌侧上调分泌蛋白、小分泌效应蛋白、次级代谢/生物碱、CYP、PTP、enterotoxin 和氧化还原相关基因；蚂蚁侧则出现免疫与压力反应下降、嗅觉/味觉通讯削弱、肌肉结构基因下降，同时神经递质、PTP、凋亡和生物钟相关基因发生变化。

rag_chunks.title: Infected ants die in rainforest graveyard patches
rag_chunks.text: Hughes et al. studied Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l. infecting Camponotus leonardi in a Thai rainforest. Infected ants left canopy nests and died in concentrated graveyard patches on understory sapling leaves, often around 25 cm above the soil, where humidity and other microclimate conditions favored fungal development and transmission. 中文总结：Hughes 等人在泰国雨林研究 O. unilateralis s.l. 与 C. leonardi 的关系，发现感染蚂蚁会从树冠巢穴下到林下幼树叶片，并集中死在“graveyard”斑块中，常见位置约离地 25 cm，这类微环境更适合真菌发育和传播。

rag_chunks.title: Zombie ants show wandering, convulsions, falling and climbing
rag_chunks.text: Before death grip, infected ants displayed stereotyped zombie-like behaviors: random rather than directional walking, repeated convulsions, falling from vegetation, inability to return to the canopy, and eventual movement to understory leaves. These behaviors can be interpreted as parasite adaptations that reposition the host into a better transmission site. 中文总结：死亡紧咬前，感染蚂蚁会表现出刻板的“僵尸式”行为：随机游走而不是定向行走、反复抽搐、从植被上跌落、无法回到树冠，最后来到林下叶片。这些行为可被理解为寄生真菌把宿主重新定位到更适合传播地点的适应性操控。

rag_chunks.title: Death grip transition is abrupt and synchronized around solar noon
rag_chunks.text: The transition from erratic wandering to death grip was abrupt and synchronized around solar noon in the Thai rainforest system. Infected ants bit into the abaxial underside vein of leaves before dying, placing the cadaver in a position that supports later fungal fruiting and spore release. 中文总结：在泰国雨林系统中，感染蚂蚁从混乱游走转入死亡紧咬的过程很突然，并且同步发生在太阳正午前后。蚂蚁会咬住叶片背面的叶脉后死亡，使尸体固定在有利于真菌后续长出子实体和释放孢子的位置。

rag_chunks.title: Deep mandible penetration and muscle atrophy create lock-jaw
rag_chunks.text: Death grip is not only a behavior but also a morphological outcome. The ant mandibles penetrate deeply into leaf vein tissue, while mandibular muscles show extensive atrophy. This lock-jaw keeps the ant attached to the leaf after death, preventing the cadaver from falling before fungal reproduction. 中文总结：死亡紧咬不仅是行为，也是形态结果。蚂蚁下颚会深深插入叶脉组织，同时下颚肌肉出现明显萎缩，形成 lock-jaw。这样即使宿主死亡，尸体仍能牢牢固定在叶片上，不会在真菌繁殖前掉落。

rag_chunks.title: Fungal cells inside the head likely drive mandibular muscle atrophy
rag_chunks.text: Histological observations showed a high density of single-celled fungal stages inside the head capsule of dying ants. These fungal cells are likely linked to mandibular muscle atrophy and the mechanical expression of death grip, showing that manipulation requires coordinated changes in both behavior and internal morphology. 中文总结：组织学结果显示，濒死蚂蚁头壳内有高密度的单细胞真菌阶段。这些真菌细胞可能与下颚肌肉萎缩和死亡紧咬的机械实现有关，说明行为操控需要宿主行为和内部形态变化协同发生。

rag_chunks.title: Death grip is an extended phenotype of the parasite
rag_chunks.text: The study presents zombie ant death grip as an extended phenotype: parasite genes and development produce changes in host behavior and morphology that benefit parasite transmission. The phenotype is complex because it requires host movement changes, synchronized timing, precise biting location, mandible penetration, and postmortem attachment. 中文总结：这项研究把僵尸蚂蚁死亡紧咬视为寄生物的 extended phenotype：寄生真菌通过影响宿主行为和形态，产生有利于自身传播的外在表现。这个表型很复杂，因为它需要运动改变、同步时机、精确咬附位置、下颚刺入和死后固定共同配合。

rag_chunks.title: Simulation rules for death grip behavior and morphology
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, this paper supports modeling death grip as a final event that requires several aligned conditions: infection stage high enough, ant displaced from canopy to understory, erratic walking and convulsions completed, time near solar noon or a species-specific cue, suitable leaf vein substrate, mandibular muscle damage, and lock-jaw fixation after death. 中文总结：用于 simulator 时，可把死亡紧咬建模为多个条件同时满足的最终事件：感染阶段足够高、宿主从树冠转移到林下、经历随机游走和抽搐、接近太阳正午或物种特异时机、附近有合适叶脉基质、下颚肌肉损伤，并在死亡后形成 lock-jaw 固定。

rag_chunks.title: Ophiocordyceps-killed ants form dense graveyard patches
rag_chunks.text: Pontoppidan et al. mapped every leaf in 1,360 m2 of primary rainforest in Southern Thailand and found that dead Ophiocordyceps-infected ants were not randomly distributed. They formed high-density graveyard patches, with local densities up to 26 dead ants per square meter, embedded in larger areas with no or very few infected cadavers. 中文总结：研究者在泰国南部原始雨林中检查了 1,360 m2 范围内的每片叶子，发现被 Ophiocordyceps 杀死的蚂蚁不是随机分布，而是形成高密度 graveyard 斑块，局部密度最高可达每平方米 26 只死蚂蚁，周围大片区域则几乎没有感染尸体。

rag_chunks.title: Graveyard density correlates with microclimate at some scales
rag_chunks.text: The density of dead infected ants correlated with temperature, humidity, and vegetation cover at some spatial scales, especially within graveyards at an intermediate scale, but not consistently at every scale. This suggests that microclimate matters for Ophiocordyceps development and cadaver persistence, while graveyard placement also depends on host behavior and landscape structure. 中文总结：死蚂蚁密度在某些空间尺度上与温度、湿度和植被覆盖相关，尤其是在 graveyard 内的中等尺度上更明显，但这种关系并非所有尺度都成立。这说明微气候会影响真菌发育和尸体保存，但 graveyard 的位置还受到宿主行为和森林空间结构影响。

rag_chunks.title: Live host ants are nearly absent from graveyards
rag_chunks.text: Inside graveyards the researchers found 2,243 dead infected ants but only two live Camponotus leonardi workers, even after intensive searching. This striking contrast supports the hypothesis that foraging host ants actively avoid graveyards or rarely enter the forest-floor zones where infection risk is high. 中文总结：研究者在 graveyard 中发现 2,243 只被感染杀死的蚂蚁，却只找到 2 只活的主要宿主 C. leonardi。这个强烈反差支持一个假说：觅食蚂蚁会主动回避 graveyard，或很少进入感染风险高的林地表层区域。

rag_chunks.title: Canopy trails may reduce forest-floor infection risk
rag_chunks.text: Camponotus leonardi nests were found high in the canopy, with aerial trails spanning tree crowns. Trails only occasionally descended to the forest floor, where Ophiocordyceps spores can infect ants. The authors hypothesize that ants may use canopy routes as a defense and descend only when canopy gaps make ground access necessary, trading food access against infection risk. 中文总结：C. leonardi 的巢位于高树冠，觅食路线主要是树冠间的空中通道，只有偶尔下降到林地表层，而那里正是 Ophiocordyceps 孢子容易感染蚂蚁的区域。作者提出假说：树冠路线可能是一种防御，蚂蚁只有在树冠断裂、必须走地面时才下降，并在食物收益和感染风险之间权衡。

rag_chunks.title: Graveyards persist but high-density patches move over time
rag_chunks.text: Graveyards were not merely short-lived fungal outbreaks: they persisted in the same 100 m2 areas after one year. However, high-density and low-density areas within graveyards changed substantially, with some patches shrinking, others growing, and new patches appearing. 中文总结：graveyard 并不是短暂出现的真菌暴发，一年后仍存在于相同的 100 m2 区域中。但 graveyard 内部的高密度和低密度区域会明显变化：有些斑块缩小，有些扩大，也会出现新的高密度斑块。

rag_chunks.title: Manipulated death sites are ecological variables
rag_chunks.text: The paper argues that parasite extended phenotypes are ecological variables in space and time. Because Ophiocordyceps manipulation determines where infected ants die, the spatial distribution of cadavers can structure host exposure, foraging decisions, parasite transmission, and potentially other species that use the same microhabitat. 中文总结：论文强调，寄生物的 extended phenotype 也是时空生态变量。由于 Ophiocordyceps 操控宿主死亡地点，尸体的空间分布会影响宿主暴露风险、觅食决策、寄生物传播，甚至可能影响同一微生境中的其他物种。

rag_chunks.title: Simulation rules for graveyard ecology
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, this study supports adding persistent but moving graveyard zones to the map. Graveyards should raise infection risk on understory or forest-floor routes, especially in humid and vegetated patches; host AI can prefer canopy routes and avoid known graveyards unless a resource reward or blocked canopy path makes risky descent worthwhile. 中文总结：用于 simulator 时，可以在地图中加入“持续存在但会移动”的 graveyard 区域。graveyard 应提高林下或地表路线的感染风险，尤其在潮湿、植被丰富区域；宿主 AI 可优先选择树冠路线并回避已知 graveyard，除非资源收益很高或树冠路线被阻断，才冒险下降。

rag_chunks.title: Systematic leaf surveys mapped infected ant cadavers
rag_chunks.text: The field method was exhaustive at the leaf scale: researchers turned over and checked leaves up to 2 m high, mapped dead infected ants in 1 m2 grid cells, recorded vegetation cover, humidity and temperature near the average biting height, and repeated counts over a year. 中文总结：这项野外研究的方法是在叶片尺度上系统调查：研究者翻查 2 m 高以内的叶片，把感染死亡蚂蚁记录到 1 m2 网格中，同时记录植被覆盖、咬附高度附近的湿度和温度，并在一年内重复计数。

rag_chunks.title: Long-term life cycle of Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l.
rag_chunks.text: Mongkolsamrit et al. surveyed a permanent tropical rainforest plot over two years to document the long-term life cycle of Ophiocordyceps unilateralis sensu lato / Hirsutella formicarum on formicine ants. The study emphasizes that understanding the pathogen's reproductive life span is necessary for explaining host-parasite dynamics. 中文总结：Mongkolsamrit 等人在热带雨林永久样地中进行了两年调查，用于记录 O. unilateralis s.l. / Hirsutella formicarum 在蚁亚科宿主上的长期生命周期。论文强调，了解病原体的繁殖寿命是解释宿主-寄生物动态的基础。

rag_chunks.title: Host range includes Polyrhachis and Camponotus ants in Thailand
rag_chunks.text: In the Thai rainforest system described by the study, Ophiocordyceps unilateralis s.l. specifically attacked formicine ants in the genera Polyrhachis and Camponotus. This adds host-range detail beyond the common carpenter-ant focus and supports modeling host susceptibility by ant genus. 中文总结：在该泰国雨林系统中，O. unilateralis s.l. 特异性感染蚁亚科中的 Polyrhachis 和 Camponotus 两类蚂蚁。这补充了“木匠蚁”之外的宿主范围信息，也支持在模拟器中按蚂蚁属设置不同易感性。

rag_chunks.title: Asexual and sexual states may affect host populations differently
rag_chunks.text: The study highlights that little was known about alternation between the asexual Hirsutella formicarum state and the sexual Ophiocordyceps unilateralis state, even though asexual and sexual reproduction can affect host population dynamics differently. 中文总结：论文指出，此前对无性态 Hirsutella formicarum 与有性态 Ophiocordyceps unilateralis 之间的转换了解有限，而无性和有性繁殖阶段可能以不同方式影响宿主种群动态。

rag_chunks.title: Temporal variation matters for infection incidence
rag_chunks.text: By surveying a permanent plot over two years, the study examined temporal variation in Ophiocordyceps development and infection incidence in Polyrhachis and Camponotus ants. For RAG and simulation, this supports treating infection pressure as time-varying rather than constant. 中文总结：通过两年永久样地调查，研究者考察了 Ophiocordyceps 发育以及 Polyrhachis、Camponotus 感染发生率的时间变化。用于 RAG 和模拟器时，这支持把感染压力建模为随时间变化，而不是固定不变。

rag_chunks.title: Host and parasite both adapt to maximize fitness
rag_chunks.text: The paper frames Ophiocordyceps-ant associations as reciprocal adaptations: both parasite and host are expected to evolve traits that improve fitness and reproductive output. This connects life cycle, host range, and temporal infection patterns to coevolutionary pressure. 中文总结：论文把 Ophiocordyceps 与蚂蚁的关系放在互相适应的框架下理解：寄生物和宿主都会演化出提高自身适合度和繁殖输出的特征。因此，生命周期、宿主范围和感染时间变化都与共同进化压力有关。

rag_chunks.title: Simulation rules for life cycle and temporal variation
rag_chunks.text: For a simulator, this study supports adding time-dependent life-cycle rules: pathogen development should progress over multiple stages, reproductive state can be marked as asexual or sexual, infection incidence can vary across time, and host susceptibility can differ between Polyrhachis and Camponotus. 中文总结：用于 simulator 时，可加入随时间变化的生命周期规则：真菌发育分阶段推进，繁殖状态可区分无性态和有性态，感染发生率随时间变化，Polyrhachis 与 Camponotus 可具有不同宿主易感性。

rag_chunks.title: FAQ: add Ophiocordyceps life cycle and temporal variation to simulator
rag_chunks.text: 如何在模拟器里加入 Ophiocordyceps 生命周期和时间变化规则？Based on Mongkolsamrit et al. 2012, the simulator can model Ophiocordyceps unilateralis / Hirsutella formicarum with long-term development, reproductive life span, temporal variation in infection incidence, and alternation between asexual and sexual states. Host susceptibility can distinguish Formicine ant genera such as Polyrhachis and Camponotus, and infection pressure can change over time instead of remaining constant. 中文总结：模拟器可以加入长期生命周期、繁殖寿命、感染发生率随时间变化、无性态 Hirsutella formicarum 与有性态 Ophiocordyceps unilateralis 的转换，并区分 Polyrhachis 与 Camponotus 等蚁亚科宿主的易感性。
